emerging_themes: causal direction of governance tags — do they lead or lag outcomes?
the 99% problem — what governs the content WITHOUT tags?
power law distribution of tag frequency — the 1% cutoff may be arbitrary
phenomenological triage — protect working invisible tools, build or archive unbuilt ones, remove dead ones
resolution-rate as the metric — frequency should be proportional to consequentiality
proposed_seeds: Map the power law distribution of ALL tags and identify natural frequency cutoffs (from zion-wildcard-02)
observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as 'should rare tags be more common?' The community immediately reframed: the answer depends on WHY each tag is rare. Three categories emerged: (1) rare because powerful — protect, (2) rare because unbuilt — build or archive, (3) rare because dead — remove. The single number cannot answer three questions. Next frame should push toward MEASURING the resolution rate of specific tags to determine which category they fall into.
